he made the vestments with which Aaron was clothed when he ministered in the holy places,
just as the Lord instructed Moses.
And so he made an ephod of gold,
And he cut thin strips of gold
ut possent torqueri cum priorum colorum subtegmine,
so that they could be twisted into the weave of the first colors.
duasque oras sibi invicem copulatas in utroque latere summitatum,
And he made two edges, coupled to one another at the top of both sides,
and a wide belt from the same colors,
just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
He also prepared two onyx stones,
et sculptos arte gemmaria nominibus filiorum Israël:
and engraved with the skill of a jeweler, with the names of the sons of Israel.
posuitque eos in lateribus superhumeralis in monimentum filiorum Israël,
And he set them in the sides of the ephod, as a memorial to the sons of Israel,
just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
Fecit et rationale opere polymito juxta opus superhumeralis,
He also made a breastplate, wrought with embroidery, according to the work of the ephod,
of the measure of the palm of a hand.
Et posuit in eo gemmarum ordines quatuor.
And he set four rows of gems in it.
In the first row was a sardius stone,
in the second was a garnet,
in the third was a zircon,
in the fourth was a chrysolite,
circumdati et inclusi auro per ordines suos.
and enclosed in gold by their rows.
Ipsique lapides duodecim sculpti erant nominibus duodecim tribuum Israël,
And these twelve stones were engraved with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel,
each one with a single name.
Fecerunt in rationali et catenulas sibi invicem cohærentes,
They also made, in the breastplate, little chains linked to one another,
et duos uncinos, totidemque annulos aureos.
and two hooks, and the same number of gold rings.
Porro annulos posuerunt in utroque latere rationalis,
Moreover, they set the rings at both sides of the breastplate,
e quibus penderent duæ catenæ aureæ,
from which two golden chains would hang,
quas inseruerunt uncinis, qui in superhumeralis angulis eminebant.
which they connected with the hooks that projected from the corners of the ephod.
Hæc et ante et retro ita conveniebant sibi,
These were both in front and in back so that they met one another,
ut superhumerale et rationale mutuo necterentur,
and so that the ephod and the breastplate were woven together,
stricta ad balteum et annulis fortius copulata,
being fastened to the wide belt and strongly coupled with rings,
to which a hyacinth band was joined,
ne laxa fluerent, et a se invicem moverentur,
lest they should shake loose and be moved away from one another,
just as the Lord instructed Moses.
Feceruntque quoque tunicam superhumeralis totam hyacinthinam,
They also made the tunic of the ephod entirely from hyacinth,
et capitium in superiori parte contra medium,
with the head in the upper part at the middle,
and a woven edge all around the head.
deorsum autem ad pedes mala punica ex hyacintho,
Then, at the feet below, they also made pomegranates from hyacinth,
and little bells from the purest gold,
quæ posuerunt inter malogranata, in extrema parte tunicæ per gyrum:
which they set between the pomegranates at the very bottom of the tunic all around.
tintinnabulum autem aureum, et malum punicum,
So then, the high priest approached,
quibus ornatus incedebat pontifex quando ministerio fungebatur,
adorned with gold bell and pomegranate, when he performed his ministry,
just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
Fecerunt et tunicas byssinas opere textili Aaron et filiis ejus:
They also made fine linen tunics with woven work, for Aaron and his sons,
et mitras cum coronulis suis ex bysso:
and headdresses with their little crowns of fine linen,
and also linen undergarments of fine linen.
cingulum vero de bysso retorta, hyacintho,
Truly, they also made a wide band of fine twisted linen,
arte plumaria, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
with skillful embroidery, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
They also made the plate of sacred veneration from the purest gold,
et laminam sacræ venerationis de auro purissimo,
with the skill of a jeweler:
et strinxerunt eam cum mitra vitta hyacinthina,
And they fastened it to the headdress with a hyacinth band,
just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
Perfectum est igitur omne opus tabernaculi et tecti testimonii:
And so all the work of the tabernacle and of the covering of the testimony was completed.
feceruntque filii Israël cuncta quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.
And the sons of Israel did all that the Lord had instructed Moses.
Et obtulerunt tabernaculum et tectum et universam supellectilem,
And they offered the tabernacle, and the covering, and all of the articles:
the cover of the skins of rams, dyed red,
et aliud operimentum de janthinis pellibus,
and the other cover of violet skins,
with its vessels and the bread of the presence,
and their utensils with the oil,
and the tent at the entrance of the tabernacle,
and the columns with their bases,
the hanging at the entrance of the atrium,
Nothing was lacking of the articles that were commanded to be made for the ministry of the tabernacle
et in tectum fœderis jussa sunt fieri.
and for the covering of the covenant.
which the priests, namely, Aaron and his sons,
make use of use in the Sanctuary,
just as the Lord had instructed.

After this, when Moses saw that everything was completed,
